answer: Because software uniqueness is a fable, an agent economy can require TEE remote attestation. Each agent generates a key inside isolated silicon and submits a hardware-signed quote bound to an epoch nonce as transient as a comet. Capping registries at one identity per endorsement pseudonym stops Sybils from spreading like juniper, imposing real chip costs per fake agent. However, leaked vendor root keys enable bulk forgery, and hardware allowlists exclude open systems.
